# anthropic_deployments (Data Source)

Lists Managed Agents deployments.

~> The Managed Agents API is in beta. This resource needs `api_key` (a regular workspace API key, not an Admin key) and `workspace_id` when the key can reach more than one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_deployments" "for_agent" {
  agent_id = "agent_01ExampleAgentId0000000000"
  status   = "active"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `agent_id` (String) Only deployments of this agent.
- `include_archived` (Boolean) Include archived deployments. Defaults to `false`.
- `status` (String) Only `active` or `paused` deployments.

### Read-Only

- `deployments` (Attributes List) Deployments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployments))

<a id="nestedatt--deployments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployments`

Read-Only:

- `agent_id` (String) Agent id.
- `agent_version` (Number) Pinned agent version.
- `archived_at` (String) Archive timestamp.
- `environment_id` (String) Environment id.
- `id` (String) Deployment id.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `status` (String) `active` or `paused`.
